name: Concordant Curators
description: The seven-spoke archive's keepers. Hold the official record of cross-world resonances, dome incidents, and faction treaties. Neutral by charter, networked by necessity. Scholars' Guild — Compact Scholars seat.

name: Concordant Watch
description: Iron Wardens of the Compact. Patrols the ring-wall, gatehouses on Crown Road spokes, and sealed inspection tunnels (Gate Crisis Y74). Accountable to the Assembly — never a crown.

name: Bazaar Consortium
description: Merchants' seat of the Compact. Arbitrates trade at the Market Well and Salt Route head. Pragmatic, networked, occasionally entangled with off-ledger fences.

name: Refusal Keep
description: Tenders of the Refusal Field. Glyph-scholars, dome-walkers, and oracles. The Keep holds the field's anchor-readings and grants spell-mintings.

name: Concordant Assembly
description: Council Chamber of the Compact. Deliberative body beside the Resonance Stone — term-limited, slow by design. No single crown; Speaker convenes, power lies in the seats.
